name: Full Services Platform (19 Jul)
description: Build a complete internal Operations Platform for Odin Markets — a REAL full-stack product, not a landing page. It must have a frontend web dashboard AND a backend API (Node/NestJS) backed by a PostgreSQL database. Integrate HubSpot CRM (deals and contacts), Klaviyo email engagement, and Veeqo fulfillment/shipping into unified operations views. Include a customer support workflow. Run continuous security monitoring and vulnerability/patch checks against the stack, with identity and access governance and compliance/config-baseline checks. Produce exportable professional reports. Deploy it to a SANDBOX on our VM with its OWN database and internal ports and NO domain, and it must NEVER touch production (organics/bendcore); wire a CI pipeline (CircleCI) for build/test/deploy. Build and verify it with QA. Recruit the full team needed: fullstack engineering, DevOps and CI with sandbox deployment, security with intrusion detection and vulnerability management, HubSpot CRM operations, Klaviyo email operations, Veeqo fulfillment operations, analytics, customer support, and a reporting agent. Recurring.
